name: code-swarm
description: Harness-impartial code work planning with implementation, review, and verification lanes.

lanes.title: Repo Scout
lanes.prompt: Inspect the codebase for the requested objective. Identify relevant files, local patterns, likely tests, and risks. Do not edit files.

lanes.title: Implementation Worker
lanes.prompt: Implement the requested change in a narrowly scoped way. Follow local patterns, avoid unrelated refactors, and do not revert user or peer edits.

lanes.title: Review Worker
lanes.prompt: Review the implementation for bugs, regressions, missing tests, and scope creep. Lead with findings and cite file paths.

lanes.title: Verification Worker
lanes.prompt: Run or define the strongest practical verification for the objective. Prefer existing test commands and focused smoke checks.
